paragraphs: BetterAge offers older adults a program for finding small steps they can take to get more out of life, at no charge. The company states a belief that everyone, regardless of age, should be able to live well and age well. It treats aging as more than a health question.

The program runs in three stages. A person begins by taking a health and well-being assessment. That produces a personalized report and a set of recommendations to explore. The last stage is about knowing you are taking the right steps.

BetterAge describes itself as a public benefit corporation. Its stated mission is improving the health and well-being of millions of older adults around the world through insights and engagement. James Firman is named as its founder. The site reports a $2.5 million SBIR grant from the National Institute on Aging.
